title: Two swap partitions despite one single installation?
body: Pretty much what the name says: I recently installed Arch Linux via the guided installer, made a partition set that normally works for me, but somehow one look with lsblk shows not one, but two swap partitions, one as part of the SSD i installed it on (the intended swap partition), one just named zram0, which I don't know which SSD it's on. How can I figure out which physical device the zram0 volume is part of, and ideally either delete it or replace it with the intended swap partition?
